contact.title: Hi, I’m Manpreet Singh.
description: Motion designer and VFX artist with nearly two decades of experience across television, film and fintech marketing, from broadcast openers for live sports to UI animation for tech products. I turn complex ideas into clear, high-impact visuals.

I’ve worked across Dubai, Doha, San Francisco and Calgary, between product, marketing and broadcast, in Cinema 4D, After Effects and Figma. My philosophy is simple: taste and polish should always serve clarity and purpose.
Recognised with a Bronze Clio for the ESPN College Football National Championship and a Silver New York Festival Award for the Jump Studios Demo Reel.

projects.title: Helcim Brand Evolution
projects.description: Animated this manifesto to launch the company's new "North Star" brand identity. The goal? Ditch the generic B2B tech look and build a "brand with teeth." This video introduces a provocative, merchant-focused design system built to disrupt the payments space.

projects.title: Card Reader Ads
projects.description: From sleek 3D studio environments to dynamic live-action VFX, I created this campaign to launch the Helcim Card Reader's new colorful stands. The project contrasts clean, minimalist 3D product animations with an energetic mixed-media promo featuring a vibrant color-reveal effect over live-action footage.

projects.title: Savings Ads
projects.description: A series of 3D motion graphic ads designed for the Helcim payments platform. These short, punchy animations use playful visual metaphors, from isometric office growth to a literal "lifesaver" for your sinking savings, to highlight Helcim’s flexible payment solutions and cost saving benefits.

projects.title: Payment Extension Launch
projects.description: I animated this product launch video for the Helcim Payment Extension. The spot uses clean UI animations to demonstrate how the browser extension seamlessly integrates into a user's existing software, allowing them to process transactions with a single click.

projects.title: Smart Terminal Launch Video
projects.description: I animated this product launch video for the Helcim Smart Terminal. The spot seamlessly blends live-action footage of small business owners with stylized 3D environments and crisp UI animations. It effectively communicates the terminal's built-in features, transparent pricing, and ease of use in a single, cohesive narrative.

projects.title: Product test drives
projects.description: Streamlining the payment experience. I animated this pair of product walkthroughs to highlight Helcim’s QuickBooks integration and Recurring Payments software. By blending sleek 3D motion graphics with clean UI animations, these spots show users exactly how easy it is to automate billing and sync invoices.

projects.title: Smart Terminal scenes
projects.description: Sleek hardware meets vibrant 3D design. This pair of product animations showcases the Helcim Smart Terminal in both black and white models. Using dynamic lighting, floating translucent glass elements, and seamless transitions to a digital laptop interface, these spots elevate point of sale hardware into the premium space.

projects.title: Virtual Terminal
projects.description: A sleek product film created to showcase the Helcim Virtual Terminal. Combining polished 3D desktop environments with clean UI animations and lifestyle live-action, this video highlights how easily businesses can process online payments from any internet-connected device.

projects.title: Payments that fuels ambition
projects.description: A pair of playful live-action ads created for the Helcim Smart Terminal. These fast-paced spots use dynamic frame transitions to showcase how Helcim’s hardware connects and empowers ambitious business owners.

projects.title: Start Card
projects.description: Quick, colorful, and seamless. I created this 3D product spot for the Start Card to highlight a successful transaction through smooth motion graphics and vivid, high-contrast lighting.

projects.title: Hidden Fee Tracker
projects.description: I animated this fast-paced, typography-driven ad for Helcim, calling out the industry's hidden fees and predatory contracts. The spot uses aggressive text scaling, kinetic typography, and bold colors to deliver a provocative message about fair pricing.

projects.title: Products Spinning
projects.description: I created this vibrant 3D motion graphics piece to showcase a seamless digital payment suite. I designed a pastel, abstract environment to frame the floating UI, using sleek, folding transitions to highlight features like quick online payments, recurring subscriptions, and one-click invoicing.

projects.title: Smart Terminal Launch
projects.description: A 3D product launch video for the Helcim Smart Terminal. The animation uses dramatic, low-key lighting and exploded views to highlight the hardware's premium features, including a wider touchscreen and octa-core processor.

projects.title: International Women's Day
projects.description: I animated this illustrated short film to announce Helcim's International Women's Day partnership with Chic Geek. Combining expressive watercolor reveals with stylized character illustrations, the piece is an empowering message that drives awareness for their March 8 donation campaign.

projects.title: April Fool 2025
projects.description: I created this vibrant 3D motion graphics piece for Helcim's April Fools' Day campaign. The animation uses smooth exploded-view transitions to reveal a payment chip, playfully suggesting you can turn anything—from a stuffed animal to sunglasses—into a point-of-sale system.

projects.title: Filmora 13 Launch
projects.description: The video uses a mix of live-action scenarios and slick UI animations to demonstrate how tools like the AI Copilot and Text-Based Editing streamline the creative process for videographers, podcasters, and small business owners.
projects.tools: Cinema 4D, After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop

projects.title: Pet Feeder Ad
projects.description: I designed this continuous-shot 3D product film to launch the SmartFeeder. The animation highlights the feeder's colorful, modern design and smart features, with every camera movement and product beat locked perfectly to the musical score.

projects.title: Beer Can Splash
projects.description: A high-impact 3D splash animation for the "Das Helcim Hefe" beer can. This product visualization features realistic liquid simulations and detailed condensation mapping to create a striking, photorealistic aesthetic.
